sourceContext.originPage: WKND adventure detail page (Bali Surf Camp)

contentPattern.structure: tab label -> rich-text body panel (paragraphs, sub-headings, lists, inline images)
contentPattern.panelContent: long-form rich text: paragraphs, bold sub-headings, bullet lists, and inline images

suitableFor: adventure detail body content (overview / itinerary / what to bring)
any tabbed switcher whose panels contain rich-text reading content with inline images
detail/article pages that split long-form body copy across tabs
notSuitableFor: category/filter tabs that reveal a grid of teaser cards (use tabs-adventure)
single non-interactive content block (use default content)

notes: Distinct from tabs-adventure: tabs-adventure is a light CATEGORY FILTER whose panels reveal cards-adventure grids (purpose adventure-filter, noimg). tabs-detail hosts rich-text body content with inline images on the adventure detail template. Shared across all 16 adventure detail pages.
